answer: ANSWER: None of the patient volume groups show a statistically significant difference (p<0.05) in COVID-19 severity between BCG and placebo. In the primary chi-square analysis (binary severity = most severe COVID-19 AE with AESEV>=2, no-COVID subjects counted as mild/none): 1-50 patients p=0.698 (chi2=0.151), 51-100 patients p=0.421 (chi2=0.647), >100 patients p=1.000 (Fisher exact, expected count <5). This null result is robust across every sensitivity analysis (AEHS>=3 threshold, COVID-AE subjects only, outcome-based severity, and multi-level AESEV chi-square): no group reaches p<0.05 under any definition, the closest being the 51-100 group under the AEHS>=3 threshold (p=0.093, Fisher).
